changelogFragments: Rename the `gen_ai.provider.name` value `mistral_ai` to `mistral` to match Mistral's brand name.
Make retrieval document `id` and `score` optional so instrumentations can omit values that are unavailable at runtime.
Warn that `gen_ai.tool.description` and `gen_ai.tool.definitions` may contain sensitive information.
Allow `gen_ai.conversation.id` on `execute_tool` spans when available.
Add `gen_ai.client.embeddings.duration` and `gen_ai.client.embeddings.operation.input_tokens` metrics, consolidate embeddings client span and metrics in `client-embeddings.md`.
Mark `gen_ai.agent.name` as sampling-relevant on `create_agent`, `invoke_agent` client, and `invoke_agent` internal spans.
Add `gen_ai.invoke_workflow.duration` metric to track duration of a workflow.
Add missing `gen_ai.tool.call.arguments` and `gen_ai.tool.call.result` opt-in attributes to MCP server span.
Add GenAI memory operation span and attributes for memory store lifecycle (create/delete), memory record create/update/upsert/search/delete operations, and record counts.

Add `document` value to the `Modality` enum in the GenAI input/output/system-instructions message JSON schemas. Enables capturing PDF/DOCX (and similar) parts that today have to fall through to the free-form `string` branch of the modality `anyOf`.
Add `gen_ai.conversation.compacted` on GenAI inference spans and `CompactionPart` message schema support for reporting compacted GenAI conversation context.

Add `gen_ai.prompt.version` and `gen_ai.prompt.variable` attributes to enhance prompt tracking with version support and template variable recording. ([#137](https://github.com/open-telemetry/semantic-conventions-genai/issues/137))
Add A2A protocol semantic conventions for client/server spans, covering protocol, message,
Add `gen_ai.invoke_agent.duration` metric to track the end-to-end duration of a single agent invocation, and `gen_ai.execute_tool.duration` metric to track the duration of a single tool execution.
Clarify that when a provider reports both billed and consumed token counts (for example, Cohere), `gen_ai.usage.input_tokens` and `gen_ai.usage.output_tokens` SHOULD report the billed counts.

Generalize the `gen_ai.provider.name` description: remove inference-centric paragraphs, and add guidance for per-operation semantic conventions to clarify which kinds of providers apply when it is not clear from context.

Relax `gen_ai.provider.name` on `gen_ai.client.operation.duration` to `Conditionally Required`, to align with the `gen_ai.retrieval.client` and `gen_ai.memory.client` spans which already allow omitting `gen_ai.provider.name`.
Clarify that a GenAI span SHOULD cover the duration of the operation as observed by the caller, including any retries.
Change `gen_ai.request.top_k` type from `double` to `int` and scope it to decoding only. Retrieval spans now use the new `gen_ai.retrieval.top_k` attribute instead of `gen_ai.request.top_k`.
Clarify that `gen_ai.request.top_k` is the top-K sampling/decoding parameter (e.g., Anthropic `top_k`, Cohere `k`) and not OpenAI's `top_logprobs` output-shaping parameter.

Clarify that `gen_ai.conversation.id` should only be populated from an available conversation identifier, and that instrumentations should not use fallback values such as generated UUIDs, trace IDs, or request-content hashes.
Clarify MCP context propagation now that SEP-414 defines `traceparent`, `tracestate`, and `baggage` as unprefixed `params._meta` keys.
Clarify `gen_ai.agent.id` stability expectations and scope; remove it from internal agent spans.
Limit supported `gen_ai.system_instructions` part types to text.

Add `gen_ai.request.reasoning.level` attribute to record the requested reasoning/thinking effort level for inference spans. ([#189](https://github.com/open-telemetry/semantic-conventions-genai/issues/189))
Add `gen_ai.main_agent` entity definition and resource attributes, and update generator templates to support entity documentation.
Remove `gen_ai.provider.name` required attribute from the `invoke_agent` internal span.
Clarify that `gen_ai.invoke_agent.duration` is about in-proc / internal span

Align `invoke_agent` and `execute_tool` semantic attributes across spans and duration metrics; remove `gen_ai.agent.version` from `invoke_agent` internal span; mark `execute_tool` sampling-relevant attributes

Move complex-attribute JSON serialization guidance into shared Jinja rendering templates and define JSON schema/type metadata via attribute annotations so it is discoverable by Weaver. Require every complex attribute
Add `gen_ai.invoke_agent.inference_calls` and `gen_ai.invoke_agent.tool_calls` metrics to track how many inference (model) and tool calls a GenAI agent makes during a single invocation.

Add the `fetch_response` operation and `gen_ai.fetch_response.client` span for fetching a previously generated model response by its identifier without performing inference, with an OpenAI-specific refinement for the Responses API. The span also records `gen_ai.request.stream_cursor` when the fetch
Clarify when instrumentations should report `gen_ai.invoke_workflow` spans, add per-framework examples, and tighten the guidance on what `gen_ai.workflow.name` should contain.
Fix reference scenarios to use schema-compatible `gen_ai.system_instructions` values and keep message-channel system instructions in `gen_ai.input.messages`.
Clarify positional correspondence in `gen_ai.response.finish_reasons` and use `error` when an expected finish reason is not received.
Deprecate `gen_ai.output.messages[].finish_reason` in favor of `gen_ai.response.finish_reasons`.
Add `gen_ai.request.previous_response.id` attribute to reference a previous response or interaction ID when passing continuation context in multi-turn or follow-up operations.

Replace the `gen_ai.client.token.usage` histogram (and the `gen_ai.token.type` attribute it relied on) with separate per-direction, per-operation token usage histograms, so token distributions can be aggregated correctly.

Add `gen_ai.client.inference.usage.*` token counters that let consumers aggregate token spend across operations, broken down by the new `gen_ai.token.modality` attribute and by token category (cached, cache-written, reasoning).
Clarify MCP error reporting: MCP server telemetry no longer reports client-side errors as failures, while MCP client telemetry reports all JSON-RPC error codes as errors.
Allow `gen_ai.conversation.id` on invoke workflow spans when available.
Rename `gen_ai.usage.cache_creation.input_tokens` to `gen_ai.usage.cache_write.input_tokens`.
Add per-modality token usage attributes: `gen_ai.usage.{text,image,audio}.{input_tokens,output_tokens}` and `gen_ai.usage.{text,image,audio}.cache_read.input_tokens`.
Define `gen_ai.execute_tool.transfer.internal` for agent tool transfers with `gen_ai.transfer.mode` and `gen_ai.transfer.target.name`.
Clarify how MCP records JSON-RPC error codes with `error.type` and `rpc.response.status_code`.
Clarify content-upload hook behavior for failed GenAI operations.

Remove `gen_ai.usage.cache_read.input_tokens` and `gen_ai.usage.cache_write.input_tokens` from the internal `invoke_agent` span. Cache breakdowns on that span aggregate across models and inference calls, which makes them misleading; consumers should aggregate them from `gen_ai.inference.client` span
Make `gen_ai.tool.call.id` conditionally required on `execute_tool` if and only if the model or provider supplied an identifier.
Add `gen_ai.system_instructions_ref`, `gen_ai.input.messages_ref`, `gen_ai.output.messages_ref`, and `gen_ai.tool.definitions_ref` attributes referencing GenAI content stored externally.
Mark `gen_ai.agent.name` as sampling-relevant on the `execute_tool` and `plan` spans.

Add `gen_ai.skill.*` attributes recorded on the `execute_tool` span, so an agent's use of [Agent Skills](https://agentskills.io) — loading a skill's instructions, reading a bundled resource, running a bundled script — is described where the framework already exposes it, as a tool execution.
Add guidance that `gen_ai.client.inference.operation.details` event severity should be set to DEBUG (severity number 5).
Add `gen_ai.client.inference.duration` metric, consolidate inference client span, events and metrics in `client-inference.md`.
Record the token usage histograms and usage counters for every inference operation, including failed ones, with `error.type` on the histograms and `0` when no usage was received.
Define and formalize GenAI content capture and external storage upload configuration options.
Clarify that optional token usage breakdown attributes (cache, reasoning, and per-modality counts) are recommended only when available and non-zero.
Clarify in-process propagation of shared GenAI attributes, including preference for values from the instrumented library and use only on signals that explicitly reference them.

Clarify that the client inference span may have nested spans recorded by the model provider, and that its `gen_ai.response.model`, `gen_ai.response.id` and usage attributes reflect what the model provider returns for this inference operation.
Make `gen_ai.client.inference.operation.details` event recommended instead of opt-in.
Reject malformed known message parts in JSON schemas and recommend prefixing custom part types with `gen_ai.provider.name`.
Reject malformed `function` tool definitions in `gen_ai.tool.definitions` JSON schema and recommend prefixing custom tool definition types with `gen_ai.provider.name`.
Clarify the first response chunk and measurement boundaries, including authentication and retries, for the GenAI time-to-first-chunk metric and span attribute.
Add `plan` operation for GenAI agent planning/task decomposition spans.
Add `moonshot_ai` to `gen_ai.provider.name` well-known values.
